name: Bad JSON Corpus
description: Real-world invalid/malformed JSON samples, numbered and grouped by error type. Each entry carries a #in= deep link that opens the JSON Repair tool with the sample preloaded so the parse error is reproducible.
description_zh: 真实场景中的非法/损坏 JSON 样本，按错误类型编号分类。每条都附带 #in= 深链，可一键在 JSON Repair 工具中预载样本、复现报错。

items.title_en: API response cut off inside an object
items.title_zh: 接口响应在对象中途被截断
items.description_en: Backend or proxy truncated the JSON — common with timeouts or oversized responses.
items.description_zh: 后端或代理在 JSON 中途截断，常见于超时或超大响应。
items.expectedError: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 69 (line 5 column 20)

items.title_en: Trailing comma after the last element
items.title_zh: 最后一个元素后的尾随逗号
items.description_en: Hand-written or pretty-printed JSON often leaves a trailing comma that strict JSON rejects.
items.description_zh: 手写或格式化后的 JSON 常残留尾随逗号，标准 JSON 不接受。
items.expectedError: Expected double-quoted property name in JSON at position 34 (line 4 column 1)

items.description_en: Config files and JS object literals leave keys unquoted; JSON requires double quotes.
items.description_zh: 配置文件与 JS 对象字面量常省略键名引号，而 JSON 要求双引号。
items.expectedError: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 4 (line 2 column 3)

items.description_en: JSON strings must use double quotes; single quotes come from JS or shell snippets.
items.description_zh: JSON 字符串必须用双引号，单引号来自 JS 或 shell 片段。
items.expectedError: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 4 (line 2 column 3)

items.description_en: JSON has no comment syntax, but config and code samples often include them.
items.description_zh: JSON 没有注释语法，但配置与代码示例常带注释。
items.expectedError: Unexpected token '/', "// server "... is not valid JSON

items.title_zh: Python 常量 True / False / None
items.description_en: Dumped from Python dicts without json.dumps(); constants are not valid JSON.
items.description_zh: 未用 json.dumps() 直接打印的 Python 字典，常量不是合法 JSON。
items.expectedError:
Unexpected token 'T', ...""active": True,
  "r"... is not valid JSON

items.title_zh: JavaScript 常量 undefined / NaN / Infinity
items.description_en: console.log of a JS object embeds these tokens, which JSON rejects.
items.description_zh: 直接打印 JS 对象会带这些记号，JSON 不接受。
items.expectedError: Unexpected token 'u', ..." "value": undefined,"... is not valid JSON

items.title_zh: 两段 JSON 被拼接在一起
items.description_en: Streamed or appended responses glue multiple top-level values together.
items.description_zh: 流式输出或拼接响应把多个顶层值粘在一起。
items.expectedError: Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON at position 13 (line 2 column 1)

items.title_en: HTML error page returned instead of JSON
items.title_zh: 返回的是 HTML 错误页而非 JSON
items.description_en: A 502/504 from a gateway or a login redirect returns HTML; parsing it as JSON fails.
items.description_zh: 网关 502/504 或登录跳转返回了 HTML，按 JSON 解析必然失败。
items.expectedError: Unexpected token '<', "<!DOCTYPE "... is not valid JSON

items.description_en: A forgotten separator between two object members.
items.description_zh: 两个对象成员之间漏写了分隔逗号。
items.expectedError: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 20 (line 3 column 3)

items.title_en: Invalid backslash escape in a Windows path
items.title_zh: Windows 路径中的非法反斜杠转义
items.description_en: Windows paths use single backslashes; \U and \a are not valid JSON escape sequences.
items.description_zh: Windows 路径使用单反斜杠，\U 与 \a 不是合法的 JSON 转义序列。
items.expectedError: Bad escaped character in JSON at position 13 (line 1 column 14)

items.description_en: Files saved by some editors start with U+FEFF, which strict JSON.parse rejects.
items.description_zh: 部分编辑器保存的文件以 U+FEFF 开头，严格 JSON.parse 会拒绝。
items.expectedError: Unexpected token '﻿', "﻿{"name": "Alice"}" is not valid JSON

items.title_zh: BSON 风格字面量 ObjectId / ISODate
items.description_en: Pasted from MongoDB shell output; the wrappers are not JSON.
items.description_zh: 从 MongoDB shell 输出复制而来，包装函数不是 JSON。
items.expectedError:
Unexpected token 'O', ..."
  "_id": ObjectId(""... is not valid JSON

items.description_en: A well-formed document — used to confirm the tool accepts valid input.
items.description_zh: 格式正确的文档，用于确认工具能正常接受合法输入。
